answers.answer: Crafted link phrases provide the densest, most context-specific characterization because each phrase explains why the target matters within the surrounding argument. Their availability is unreliable because they require human judgment and authoring discipline; if an author omits the contextual phrase or link, the pointer is absent or weak.

The four forms are natural-language, symbolic, distributed-parametric, and mixed. Representational form describes how an artifact’s operative part is encoded and consumed, whereas storage substrate describes where or in what container it is stored. For example, Markdown can contain natural-language, symbolic, or mixed content, and a vector store can hold natural-language records while retrieval depends on distributed-parametric embeddings.

The best configuration—subtask-level tips with LLM-guided retrieval—reported a 14.3 percentage-point improvement in scenario goal completion on held-out AppWorld tasks. The KB analysis says the learning signal depends on AppWorld’s clear, deterministic task-completion oracle, so the pipeline does not transfer as-is to domains such as open-ended knowledge work, creative tasks, or advisory work where completion signals are ambiguous or absent.
